kjv: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you
mine: See with what large letters I am writing to you with my own hand
note: pelikois grammasin is "with what large letters" (characters), Paul's own handwriting at the end of a dictated letter; the KJV makes it the length of the epistle, which is short.
